programme.title: A Thanksgiving Christmas
programme.desc: Whenever "One-Time" comes to his sister-in-law's for the holidays, he is never welcomed, but this time it is more than just Thanksgiving that brings him. Learning that he is on borrowed time, he tries to convince her to host Christmas on the same day so he can still celebrate his favorite holiday, over-the-top extended family invited and all!

programme.title: Double Blended
programme.desc: Two couples, once married to each other’s ex-spouses, form a double-blended family. Their seemingly harmonious coexistence is threatened when a past secret resurfaces, forcing them to confront their complicated relationships.

programme.title: Stick Em Game
programme.desc: Struggling to launch her social media career, Elise decides to switch to viral pranks. When one prank on an old acquaintance goes terribly wrong, a local gang leader is out for revenge. With her best friend’s help, Elise must fight for her life to survive.

programme.title: You People
programme.desc: You People is a satirical comedy about modern stereotypes, chronicling the life of an intelligent, white-washed, African American college student, adopted by a liberal Caucasian family, who has a crisis of identity while growing up in the Bible belt, white suburbia with his urban hip-hop culture obsessed, white best friend. When an attractive girl on campus approaches the black protagonist based on his 'presumed' stereotypical traits, he has to undergo a 'cultural transformation' with the help of his white companion to tap into his inner 'blackness.'

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Heavy
programme.desc: When being young and hood rich is no longer a priority Renz turns his focus to something physically and mentally finer. But when walls and barriers begin to break, things begin to get HEAVY and he realizes he has to choose between love and loyalty.

programme.title: Thanksgiving With The Carters
programme.desc: A family tries to find common ground with its newest members, as they honor their tradition of Thanksgiving surprise, where each person attempts to surprise the family with something unique and positive.

programme.title: Thanksgiving with the Carters: 2nd Helping
programme.desc: The Carter family is back together again for the Thanksgiving holiday, and this time they are celebrating at a cabin deep in the woods. When chaos ensues and dinner is ruined, the family must work together to save the holiday tradition.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Roast 2
programme.desc: Single and work-obsessed, Mya, reluctantly visits her family in North Carolina she has not seen in years, after her friend Jasmine insists. To avoid the discomforting pressure her family puts on her to get married, she hires a man to join her and play her boyfriend. Chaos ensues as soon as they arrive to meet Mya's over the top family. A wild Thanksgiving holiday is in store for all when Mya's charade does not go as planned.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: When returning home for Thanksgiving, Elliot, tries to keep cool with his meddlesome, dysfunctional family.

programme.desc: When 19 year old TJ, decides to leave the nest of his parents who are preachers of the gospel and turns to the streets for the love and support he always wanted. His life is turned upside down almost over night with gun violence, drug dealings, stolen money and countless crimes in the blink of an eye. His life becomes a tug of war between the parents that raised him and his new gang leader chief Who’s bringing him further down to the ground.

programme.title: What She Wants
programme.desc: Vannaleese Poole is a street smart, businesswoman who knows how to use what she has to get what she wants. In Her relentless thirst to make major moves, she hooks up with Jay, a big time street boss, who promises her the world, but only if she follows the rules that she isn’t willing to play by. She meets Brint, a business mogul, who falls hard for her and gives her everything she wants. A test of love will introduces her to something she never knew she wanted.

programme.title: Liquid Dreams
programme.desc: The Dawkins brothers, navigating new careers and relationships, find their bond tested when a wild night of partying sets off a chain of events. Years after their initial adventures, they face fresh challenges that threaten to tear them apart.

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash.” Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: BARS
programme.desc: Kobe lives a picture-perfect life. A devoted wife and mother, she has everything she's ever wanted. But her idyllic world shatters when she's abruptly arrested and sentenced to life in prison for a crime she didn't commit. Desperate for survival, Kobe finds solace and strength in a tight-knit group of inmates known as The Pretty Girls. Unaware of Kobe's ordeal, her twin sister Shaq returns home only to discover the shocking truth.

programme.title: The Perfect Mother
programme.desc: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son Ahmad amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband Jeremy. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance inadvertently leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody. Linda rises to the challenge of overcoming adversary to reunite her family and save her son.

programme.desc: Brandon and Leo are two friends stuck at a dead-end job, until their boss gets arrested and the two seem to be on the upswing. Now between hiding from the IRS, a rival dealership, the road back to respectability is a long and bumpy road.

programme.title: Taboo 2
programme.desc: Roxanne moves in with her Uncle and Auntie where her past of sexual abuse against her cousins tears the family apart while discovering a deeper secret that has major consequences.

programme.title: Taboo 3
programme.desc: When Devin finally meets his soap star birth mother, Rebecca, as an adult, feelings go beyond family love.

programme.title: Swing
programme.desc: In the gritty streets of 1945 Philadelphia, aspiring jazz musician and street hustler, Trip, dreams of a life-changing opportunity awaiting him in the vibrant world of Harlem. With three days until the audition, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he finds himself entangled in a web of corruption, vengeful gangsters, and the ominous presence of a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Tainted Waters
programme.desc: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to financially save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he has to make it through the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.

programme.title: My New BFF
programme.desc: Jasmine becomes friends with Lisa, her new neighbor and current law student. Their relationship turns toxic when Lisa develops an obsession with Jasmine, putting her life, her friends, and family in danger.

programme.title: In This House
programme.desc: Claudia is a medical student focused on building a perfect life with her live-in boyfriend Dr. Jayson. Her grandfather’s death forces her to go back to her hometown to face her estranged family and her past. Once she arrives, she uncovers sinister secrets and will stop at nothing to break the generational curse stemming from her family’s history.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Betrayal at First Hand
programme.desc: After her friend Monica betrays her by sleeping with Big D, Sarah's grief quickly spirals into madness. However, her breakdown is accelerated by a shocking twist and only Big D knows the truth. He must reveal the crime to Sarah, hoping that unveiling one horrific truth can redeem him and save the woman he lost.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Sparks fly in this week’s heat as competitors put their weapons to good use and a robot uses its shape to their advantage.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The eliminator begins slowly, but as the battle heats up the robots must stay cool, or they might end up losing their head. The house robots see one of their busiest nights in the arena as they try to keep up.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Celebrities take to the arena, teaming up with veterans from the series and their robots. The celebrities must control the robots for at least 60 seconds before the professionals can take over.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six competitors, including World Champion Razer battle it out for a shot at the Fourth Wars title. Irreparable damage could mean the permanent end of one of the veteran competitors in the semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A competitor faces issues before the battle even begins in this week’s eliminators and the house robots stand by, ready to strike the final blow. The clock proves to be the enemy in this week’s Pinball Warrior, and the competitors prepare to stand their ground in Sumo Bash.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Veterans and Newcomers once again face the eliminators and Dead Metal tries to make a friend. A house robot gets flipped, causing the others to go on a rampage. A uniquely designed robot takes on Pinball Warrior and two more competitors stare down Shunt in Sumo Bash.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A single strike spells trouble for a robot in the eliminators. A fleeting alliance forms as competitor and house robot team up to make an offering to the pit. This week’s Pinball Warrior has high-hopes for a standout performance.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A robot with a unique strategy takes part in this week’s heat. Is it a recipe for success, or a fancy gimmick? The house robot’s manners are at an all-time low as they continue to attack after cease is called.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The robots take the term “facing off” literally this week as they rip each other apart. Will Shunt manage to shake off the competitors in this week’s Sumo Bash.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The heat descends into chaos as the house robots team up to take down the competitors. The judges make a controversial decision in the final to decide this week’s winner.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Over halfway through the heats and the hopefuls are still lining up to put their robots through mechanical hell, for a chance of making it to the semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This Pro Women's Doubles match at the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships features the dynamic team of Anna Leigh Waters and Lee Waters facing off against the formidable duo of Walczak and Harris. The Waters team, known for their aggressive play and powerful shots, including Anna Leigh's unique heavy topspin cross-court backhand roll, aim to dominate the court. Walczak, a native of Poland with collegiate tennis experience, and Harris seek to overcome the Waters' early lead and challenge their expected path to the Championship court.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at Mumbai's Jio World Garden is electric as the host team, Mumbai Pickle Power, rides the momentum of their first season victory into a high-stakes clash against the Rajasthan Titans. With Rajasthan still hunting for their elusive first win of the season, the pressure is at a breaking point for both squads as they fight to climb the "Band of Honor" leaderboard. Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. From game-changing "Pickle Plays" to high-stakes challenges and the presence of celebrity guests like Rishabh Pant, every rally in this tie is a desperate fight for survival on the road to the semifinals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: A high-level pickleball match from the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional as the Utah Tech collegiate program's top two teams battle head-to-head. Filmed live at Club Pickleball USA in Orem, Utah, this episode features the Women's Doubles showdown between the #2 seed Utah Tech 1, featuring Lauren Mercado and Ella Boydston, against the #3 seed Utah Tech 2, anchored by NCPA commentator Dillon Champigny and rising star Mary Monson. Experience the intense collegiate format, which includes singles, doubles, and mixed doubles, a design optimized based on direct player feedback.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: It's the final day of the 1984 Missouri Invitational on Truman Lake in Warsaw, Missouri. Charlie Ingram and Larry Williams go head to head from wire-to-wire, but only one angler can walk away as the champion. Don't miss the final moments to see who is crowned champion.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1985 Texas Memorial Invitational is nearing its conclusion at the Sam Rayburn Reservoir in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as the top anglers in the world compete to see who ascends to hoist the trophy and take home the glory.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1985 Super B.A.S.S. IV Tournament becomes an instant all-time classic as Hank Parker and Gary Klein have a showdown on the St. Johns River in Palatka, Florida. Tune in to see who emerges victorious and cements themselves in Bassmaster history.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: In Chattanooga, Tennessee, the 1985 Bassmaster Series continues with the Chattanooga Invitational, where only one angler can claim the $100,000 prize. See who rises above the rest to claim the top spot and bring home the Bassmaster Elite Series trophy.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Lake Okeechobee's legacy is cemented during the 1985 Bassmaster Series as anglers make their mark in Clewiston, Florida as the Florida Invitational comes to a close. Only one angler can stand above the rest, tune in to find out who brings home the trophy and the $100,000 prize.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1986 New York Invitational on the St. Lawrence River continues the Bassmaster Series in Clayton, New York. Jimmy Houston and Mickey Bruce take part in an all-time race to see who takes home the top prize and cements themselves in the legacy of the New York Invitational.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Join host Ray Scott as the Bassmasters tour heads to Georgia’s scenic Lake Lanier for a high-stakes invitational. Watch top anglers battle unpredictable spring conditions and fierce competition in pursuit of the coveted title. programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Super Invitational continues in 1986 on the Tennessee River in Chattanooga, Tennessee, where the top anglers in the world compete to see who will bring home the top prize. Follow along to find out who of the top anglers will rise above the rest.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Bassmasters tour heads north to the historic Hudson River for a thrilling invitational in Catskills, NY. Watch elite anglers battle tidal currents and urban waters in pursuit of bass glory. David Fenton emerges victorious with a razor-thin margin, outlasting legends like Larry Nixon and Fish Fishburne. Hosted by Ray Scott, this episode delivers intense competition, expert commentary, and scenic river views.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Join host Ray Scott and the Bassmaster crew as 250 of the nation’s top anglers descend on Florida’s legendary Lake Okeechobee. In this fall showdown, Charles “Slow-Hand” Murphy uses finesse and patience to outlast the competition and land a career-defining win.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1987 Texas Invitational is an all-time classic, taking place on the Sam Rayburn Invitational in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as top anglers compete to see who can make the most of a high-pressure situation and emerge victorious.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Bec Hughes and Fahad “Faz” Yousif look after a man who fell off a ladder while pruning his lemon tree and landed on his back. Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who landed on her head during training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the blood-soaked bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident. Dr Jonathan Papson admires a festival goer’s mohawk as he fixes his shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital handles traumas of all kinds. Dr Emma West is on high alert for a cyclist who’s been trapped under a tram. A 21-year-old with a history of sinus issues is bleeding profusely from the back of his throat, and Dr Jonathan Papson worries he could choke. Dr Michelle Thornhill fears an older man might lose his independence after he fell off a roof. Dr David Sparkhall and Dr Michael Dunne treat a motorbike rider with a badly smashed-up knee.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A young woman arrives via helicopter to the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department after her car slammed into a tree. Dr Jonathan Papson worries she’ll have life-changing injuries as her old car lacked modern safety features. Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects to find multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen three metres off a balcony. Dr Emma West calms a young mum who’s cut though her hand.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Patients arrive at all hours to the Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital. With a helicopter on the way, ED assistant Sandra Nash checks the landing pad to ensure stray debris doesn’t become a missile. Dr Tinnie Chang’s patient has severe head injuries after a horror fall off a truck. Nurse Lucy Stranger and Dr Zaheer Jayhoon fear something sinister could be happening to an otherwise cheerful woman with chest pain. Dr Bec Hughes’s young patient has puzzling abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to traumas every day. Hannah’s first shift as a MICA Paramedic puts her new skills to the test, after a woman in a store collapses, stops breathing and has no heartbeat. Sally and Olivia worry a small boy has a head injury after a fall at Grandma’s. Single-responder Dan needs to extract a P-Plate driver out of a crashed car, carefully. Aaron and Laura help a young footballer who’s smashed her face during a game - the school dance is two weeks away!

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst day. Daniel rushes to a woman having a life-threatening allergic reaction from a takeaway. She’s struggling to breathe and is terrified. Long-time workmates and housemates Sam and Chris love a laugh, but switch to serious mode after an accident in the busy nightclub district. Georgia and rookie Ben worry a young mother-to-be is about to miscarry twins. Carlos and Nhi race to stop a little boy from choking on food.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to people having their worst days. Bill rushes to a woman whose heart is racing out of control. Chris and Sam rescue a dirtbike rider, but the ‘green whistle’ makes the patient laugh away the pain. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst as they arrive at a collision between car and bus. While Laura gives a cyclist the all-clear, Aaron happily rides the man’s pushbike home. A stoic 70- year-old man who fell out of a tree with a chainsaw worries Ben and Georgia.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedic Bill races to a man having seizures. The patient is going downhill fast and could lash out at the very people trying to save him. Former horse rider Hannah fears an elite equestrian might never walk again after an horrific accident. The woman fell during a jump, and the horse rolled on top of her. Olivia and Sally become medical detectives as they examine a woman having a potential stroke. Chris and Sam know every second counts as they rush to a distraught woman struggling to breathe.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Intensive Care Paramedic Dan is in a race against time treating a woman who feels like her heart is leaping out of her chest. Laura and Aaron confront a nightmare situation after a young man crashes into a tree. It’s a chaotic scene and the driver is trapped. Nhi and Carlos have to break in to an eldery woman’s home; she’s in agony after a fall and can’t get to the door to let them in. Hannah comes to the rescue of a student who’s crash landed during a high jump and could have spinal injuries.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nhi and Carlos under pressure to bring a drug overdose patient back from the brink of death. Laura and Aaron are on their way to one job, when they come across a motorbike crash. The rider’s horrific injuries are so bad, he may never walk again. Hannah rushes to an elderly man virtually suffocating from fluid on his lungs while his beloved sweetheart fears the worst. Ben and Tarnya apply their superhero skills to a toddler who’s struggling to breathe.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A young Dad suddenly suffers frightening seizures while driving his wife and baby. Intensive care paramedic, Dan can’t believe the family are still alive. Aaron and Laura treat a serial daredevil with serious injuries after a spectacular crash from his dirt bike. Chris and Sam challenge each other to slip ‘the word of the day’ into their next case. Solo responder Bill fights heavy traffic to help a diabetic grandmother who has collapsed at home and is not responding.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Bill holds a young mother’s life in his hands, as her heart races out of control. Aaron is ready for anything as he resets a netballer’s shoulder, but is he prepared for the cheeky sportswoman’s banter? Sam has ‘man-flu’, so Chris teams up with Laura for the first time. Together they rush to help an elderly Parkinson’s patient with a growing infection that could turn septic. Aaron later joins Dan to rescue a collapsed man with critical head injuries, found in a pool of blood in a car park.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A confronting case for Nhi and Carlos as they are called to a woman running in front of traffic. The woman is in crisis and suddenly jumps out of the ambulance as the paramedics try to help her. Dan helps a star footballer who’s busted his leg at training. Sally and Olivia fear their elderly patient is having a heart attack and new dad, Bill races to a first time Mum whose baby could be having a life-threatening allergic reaction.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A terrified patient with a failing heart has Aaron and Laura on high alert. Dan is called to a stubborn local celebrity. The 79-year-old character needs to be in hospital, but doesn’t trust doctors. Nhi and Carlos share their school memories on the way to to help a teen who’s crashed landed on a basketball court. Chris and Sam meet their oldest ever patient. The stoic 104-year-old Nelly has terrible face injuries after a fall in her house but still gives the boys her secret to longevity.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Bill battles to save a woman with catastrophic head injuries after she fell four metres through a roof onto a concrete floor. Nhi and Carlos meet a delightful patient who’s still smiling after breaking her arm during a family lunch. Laura and Aaron rush to a mum who’s slumped over in her car and is unresponsive. Sally and Olivia handle a lethargic toddler with extra care, after a big bump at the playground.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A sudden collapse shocks Olivia and Sally as their patient suddenly appears to be having a heart attack. Carlos and Nhi fear for their safety as a volatile woman lashes out in the back of the ambulance. Chris and Sam’s protective instincts kick in for a teenage patient who was attacked on his way to school. It’s déjà vu for Laura as she and Aaron are called to a patient she’s treated before and desperately needs her help again.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A baby in a hurry has Bill concerned the mother will be delivering in the back of his ambulance. To add to the pressure, this is a high-risk pregnancy. A guest of honour has collapsed in front of her family at a milestone birthday celebration. Nhi and Carlos arrive at the crowded party as four generations of worried relatives look on. Aaron and Laura rush to an amputee in agony. The man tripped over after grabbing a burger and managed to dial for help with his nose!

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Australia’s Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Emma West faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, but he’s putting up a fight. Drs Jonathan Papson and Mya Cubitt race to save the life of a young man whose car slammed into a pole. Dr Mark Putland treats a factory worker who’s in shock after being confronted with his horrific life-changing injuries. A heavily pregnant young woman presents a challenge for Dr Michelle Thornhill.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A gunshot victim arrives at The Royal Melbourne Hospital under police guard. Dr Sarah Whitelaw fears the patient could die from his injuries, but the shooter is still at large, posing a risk. Dr Jonathan Papson treats a football player who could bleed to death from kidney damage, after an on-field collision. Dr Michael Dunne and nurse Lucy Stranger assess a pregnant car crash patient who can’t feel her baby move. Dr Michelle races to the waiting room after a woman mysteriously collapses.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Fiona Nicholson uses her reassuring bedside manner on a young man with a racing heart and spiking blood pressure - but she’ll have to stop his heart beating in order to save him. A patient with a gruesome head wound has Dr Sarah Whitelaw on full alert, and unseen internal injuries could make things even worse. Nurse Julia Hoiles helps a smitten young couple who spend their first date in emergency. Dr Michael Dunne treats a nurse-to-be who has smashed her leg in a car accident.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: El Primer Telepitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo vierte una poción mágica sobre el nuevo sembrado de melones, que crecen instantáneamente e inundan la aldea y el bosque. Los Pitufos usan las flores a modo de teléfono; sin embargo, antes de que Gargamel pueda rastrear sus voces, las flores se convierten en melones y eso significa el fin del telepitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda de algo novedoso, Pitufo Vanidoso se pone un sombrero mágico creado por Gargamel que le deja la cara hecha un adefesio. Mediante una argucia, Papá Pitufo consigue robarle el antídoto al malvado mago, logrando así que Pitufo Vanidoso recupere su belleza.

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: El Buen Vecino De Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de Pitufo Filósofo se quema, se muda con sus compañeros Pitufos; y, uno detrás de otro, le echan debido a sus intromisiones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La bruja Hogata promete a Gargamel un silbato mágico si este le presenta al brujo de sus sueños. Sin embargo, ambos se engañan mutuamente con sus triquiñuelas: Gargamel se disfraza de brujo, y el silbato mágico de Hogata es simplemente un reclamo para aves.

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón se disfraza de Pitufina para atraer a Piltkin, el gnomo que se ha enamorado de ella, y alejarlo de la Aldea Pitufa. Excavan bajo tierra y conocen a una gnoma que se enamora de Piltkin, quien se olvida de Pitufina y pasa a tener ojos solo para su nueva conquista.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón, que odia todo, detesta especialmente su propia fiesta de cumpleaños, por lo que decide esconderse en el Pantano de las Sombras. Allí encontrará extraños seres y vivirá aventuras aún más extrañas mientras los demás Pitufos le buscan…

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un dragón aterroriza la Aldea Pitufa. Para vencer al dragón, los Pitufos deben encontrar al famoso viajero chino. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo es capaz de entender las peculiares costumbres del extranjero, e incluso de hablar algunas palabras en su idioma.

programme.title: El Hombre De La Luna
programme.desc: Cansado y harto de que no le aprecien, el Hombre de la Luna deja su trabajo y se retira en la Tierra, en la Aldea Pitufa. La ausencia de la luna en cuarto creciente desata el caos en las costumbres de los Pitufos, y Madre Naturaleza y Padre Tiempo también se ven arrastrados por el embrollo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay un premio para aquel Pitufo que tenga la mascota más adorable. Bebé Pitufo acude con Cariño Dorado, una mascota adorable y cariñosa de la que todo el mundo se enamora. Sin embargo, esa mascota es una creación del malvado mago Gargamel con la que pretende destruir a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Símbolos De Sabiduría
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está desesperado por parecerse más a Papá Pitufo. ¿Podría ser la respuesta un tónico capilar? ¿Conseguirá Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduría en una barba?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se siente preparado para la ocasión cuando empieza a preparar una receta de galletas. Está convencido de que va a ganar el concurso, ya que ha tomado prestada una receta del libro de magia de Papá Pitufo. Sin embargo, una gran sorpresa y algunas situaciones desagradables aguardan al pobre Pitufo Filósofo y a toda la aldea.

programme.title: Secreto Del Pozo De La Aldea
programme.desc: ¿Por qué Pitufo Torpe espera día y noche junto al pozo de la aldea? ¿Cuál es el deseo que quiere mantener en secreto? ¿Y cómo está involucrado Gargamel en este asunto misterioso? ¿Logrará Gargamel atrapar por fin a los Pitufos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: Detente A Pitufar Rosas
programme.desc: La malvada hechicera Clorhidris quiere borrar todo el amor y la belleza de la faz de la tierra. Para ello, debe aniquilar la arboleda de los elfos de los bosques, donde la encantadora elfa muda Laconia cuida de las flores silvestres. Sin embargo, los Pitufos están ahí para salvar la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado Acechador, que captura animales silvestres para venderlos, tiene a Abuelo Pitufo y a Pitufo Salvaje de los nervios. Nana Pitufa y Smoogle acuden al rescate, capturando al Acechador en una de sus propias trampas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tras malinterpretar algo que oye, Pitufo Reportero publica que Gargamel desea ser amigo de los Pitufos. Gargamel convence a Pitufo Reportero para que le lleve hasta la Aldea Pitufa para hacer el anuncio en persona. Gargamel secuestra a los Pitufos, y Pitufo Reportero es ahora el responsable de escribir la historia de su rescate.

programme.title: Niñeras Chapuseras
programme.desc: Mientras Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo y Pitufo Goloso discuten, Hogata secuestra a Bebé Pitufo para preparar una fórmula para tener la piel suave como la de un bebé. Ellos tres, acompañados de Smoogle, tendrán que dejar a un lado sus rencillas para rescatar a Bebé Pitufo de las garras de Hogata.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel despide a Escrupuloso, que se va a vivir con Gigantón. Mientras los Pitufitos ayudan a Gigantón a organizar una fiesta, Escrupuloso los captura para congraciarse con Gargamel. Pero no cuenta con que Gigantón acudirá al rescate.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por pura casualidad, un elefante que pasaba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, y los Pitufos deciden crear un gran Circo. Van a visitar al hechicero infernal Baltazar y Bebé Pitufo se lo está pasando genial…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Deslizándose por un arcoíris, un caballito alado pierde una herradura dorada. Tras encontrarse con Pitufina, ambos van en su búsqueda. Al final, acaban encariñándose ya que quién podría resistirse al encanto de un caballito alado…o de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude.
