programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends

programme.title: Leo Wildlife Ranger

Con interesantes misiones y aventuras, los niños se divierten mientras aprenden lecciones positivas.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y la Selva
programme.desc: Alex vive en una casa en un árbol, en medio de la selva. Hace el desayuno cada mañana, mientras que Rocco y Lili siguen haciendo ladura vida de los demás. Un científico holográfico aparece en la máquina de Alex e informa que animal se tiene que sacar en la foto de hoy: un elefante. Por lo tanto, van en un globo de aire por los cielos de la selva. Una vez que encuentra un elefante, Alex saca su cámara y toma una foto. Una vez que ha terminado, vuelve a casa. Al final, vamos a escuchar un informe detallado acerca de los elefantes.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos. Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su misión para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín. Descubrirá todo tipo de vida submarina. Después de un rato, Alex ve un delfín y toma una foto de él. Luego, regresa de vuelta a casa. Al final, una voz explica las características de los delfines.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: Leo Wildlife Ranger

programme.title: Bernard

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: El Mundo de Luna
programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.title: Planeta de Niños
programme.desc: Divertida y cautivadora serie educativa y de entretenimiento para niños, que refuerza virtudes fundamentales y modales enseñados a los niños por sus padres y maestros, en la escuela y en casa. Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdón, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperación y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: El Mundo de Luna
programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.title: Planeta de Niños
programme.desc: Divertida y cautivadora serie educativa y de entretenimiento para niños, que refuerza virtudes fundamentales y modales enseñados a los niños por sus padres y maestros, en la escuela y en casa. Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdón, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperación y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad. Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlining the event is a light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni and Muhammed Balli. Co-headlining the event is a welterweight bout between Jay Overmeer and Robin Ciric. Also featured on the card, Tariq Osaro will face Abderrahman Barkouch in a heavyweight battle, and Nordin Ben Moh meets Kyle Todd in a lightweight fight.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the main event, former GLORY Featherweight Title Challenger Abraham Vidales will face Tomás Aguirre, a native of Argentina who has finished 22 of his 26 wins. In the co-main event, top-10 GLORY middleweight contender Ivan Galaz will meet Renan Altamiro. Also featured on the card, GLORY debutants Jonas Julio and Javier Aparicio will square off in a welterweight clash, and top-five GLORY featherweight contender Denis Wosik will go for his third consecutive victory as he takes on Marcos Rios. Additionally, top-ten GLORY lightweight contender Bruno Gazani will fight Nick Chasteen, and Tessa de Kom will replace Sarah Moussaddak (injury) and meet Giuliana Cosnard in a Super Bantamweight bout to open the card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Christmas
programme.desc: Whenever "One-Time" comes to his sister-in-law's for the holidays, he is never welcomed, but this time it is more than just Thanksgiving that brings him. Learning that he is on borrowed time, he tries to convince her to host Christmas on the same day so he can still celebrate his favorite holiday, over-the-top extended family invited and all!

programme.title: Double Blended
programme.desc: Two couples, once married to each other’s ex-spouses, form a double-blended family. Their seemingly harmonious coexistence is threatened when a past secret resurfaces, forcing them to confront their complicated relationships.

programme.title: Stick Em Game
programme.desc: Struggling to launch her social media career, Elise decides to switch to viral pranks. When one prank on an old acquaintance goes terribly wrong, a local gang leader is out for revenge. With her best friend’s help, Elise must fight for her life to survive.

programme.title: You People
programme.desc: You People is a satirical comedy about modern stereotypes, chronicling the life of an intelligent, white-washed, African American college student, adopted by a liberal Caucasian family, who has a crisis of identity while growing up in the Bible belt, white suburbia with his urban hip-hop culture obsessed, white best friend. When an attractive girl on campus approaches the black protagonist based on his 'presumed' stereotypical traits, he has to undergo a 'cultural transformation' with the help of his white companion to tap into his inner 'blackness.'

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Heavy
programme.desc: When being young and hood rich is no longer a priority Renz turns his focus to something physically and mentally finer. But when walls and barriers begin to break, things begin to get HEAVY and he realizes he has to choose between love and loyalty.

programme.title: Thanksgiving With The Carters
programme.desc: A family tries to find common ground with its newest members, as they honor their tradition of Thanksgiving surprise, where each person attempts to surprise the family with something unique and positive.

programme.title: Thanksgiving with the Carters: 2nd Helping
programme.desc: The Carter family is back together again for the Thanksgiving holiday, and this time they are celebrating at a cabin deep in the woods. When chaos ensues and dinner is ruined, the family must work together to save the holiday tradition.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Roast 2
programme.desc: Single and work-obsessed, Mya, reluctantly visits her family in North Carolina she has not seen in years, after her friend Jasmine insists. To avoid the discomforting pressure her family puts on her to get married, she hires a man to join her and play her boyfriend. Chaos ensues as soon as they arrive to meet Mya's over the top family. A wild Thanksgiving holiday is in store for all when Mya's charade does not go as planned.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: When returning home for Thanksgiving, Elliot, tries to keep cool with his meddlesome, dysfunctional family.

His life is turned upside down almost over night with gun violence, drug dealings, stolen money and countless crimes in the blink of an eye. His life becomes a tug of war between the parents that raised him and his new gang leader chief Who’s bringing him further down to the ground.

programme.title: What She Wants

In Her relentless thirst to make major moves, she hooks up with Jay, a big time street boss, who promises her the world, but only if she follows the rules that she isn’t willing to play by. She meets Brint, a business mogul, who falls hard for her and gives her everything she wants. A test of love will introduces her to something she never knew she wanted.

Unaware of Kobe's ordeal, her twin sister Shaq returns home only to discover the shocking truth.

Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. From game-changing "Pickle Plays" to high-stakes challenges and the presence of celebrity guests like Rishabh Pant, every rally in this tie is a desperate fight for survival on the road to the semifinals.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Bec Hughes and Fahad “Faz” Yousif look after a man who fell off a ladder while pruning his lemon tree and landed on his back. Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who landed on her head during training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the blood-soaked bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident. Dr Jonathan Papson admires a festival goer’s mohawk as he fixes his shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital handles traumas of all kinds. Dr Emma West is on high alert for a cyclist who’s been trapped under a tram. A 21-year-old with a history of sinus issues is bleeding profusely from the back of his throat, and Dr Jonathan Papson worries he could choke. Dr Michelle Thornhill fears an older man might lose his independence after he fell off a roof. Dr David Sparkhall and Dr Michael Dunne treat a motorbike rider with a badly smashed-up knee.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A young woman arrives via helicopter to the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department after her car slammed into a tree. Dr Jonathan Papson worries she’ll have life-changing injuries as her old car lacked modern safety features. Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects to find multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen three metres off a balcony. Dr Emma West calms a young mum who’s cut though her hand.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Patients arrive at all hours to the Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital. With a helicopter on the way, ED assistant Sandra Nash checks the landing pad to ensure stray debris doesn’t become a missile. Dr Tinnie Chang’s patient has severe head injuries after a horror fall off a truck. Nurse Lucy Stranger and Dr Zaheer Jayhoon fear something sinister could be happening to an otherwise cheerful woman with chest pain. Dr Bec Hughes’s young patient has puzzling abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to traumas every day. Hannah’s first shift as a MICA Paramedic puts her new skills to the test, after a woman in a store collapses, stops breathing and has no heartbeat. Sally and Olivia worry a small boy has a head injury after a fall at Grandma’s. Single-responder Dan needs to extract a P-Plate driver out of a crashed car, carefully. Aaron and Laura help a young footballer who’s smashed her face during a game - the school dance is two weeks away!

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst day. Daniel rushes to a woman having a life-threatening allergic reaction from a takeaway. She’s struggling to breathe and is terrified. Long-time workmates and housemates Sam and Chris love a laugh, but switch to serious mode after an accident in the busy nightclub district. Georgia and rookie Ben worry a young mother-to-be is about to miscarry twins. Carlos and Nhi race to stop a little boy from choking on food.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to people having their worst days. Bill rushes to a woman whose heart is racing out of control. Chris and Sam rescue a dirtbike rider, but the ‘green whistle’ makes the patient laugh away the pain. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst as they arrive at a collision between car and bus. While Laura gives a cyclist the all-clear, Aaron happily rides the man’s pushbike home. A stoic 70- year-old man who fell out of a tree with a chainsaw worries Ben and Georgia.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedic Bill races to a man having seizures. The patient is going downhill fast and could lash out at the very people trying to save him. Former horse rider Hannah fears an elite equestrian might never walk again after an horrific accident. The woman fell during a jump, and the horse rolled on top of her. Olivia and Sally become medical detectives as they examine a woman having a potential stroke. Chris and Sam know every second counts as they rush to a distraught woman struggling to breathe.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Intensive Care Paramedic Dan is in a race against time treating a woman who feels like her heart is leaping out of her chest. Laura and Aaron confront a nightmare situation after a young man crashes into a tree. It’s a chaotic scene and the driver is trapped. Nhi and Carlos have to break in to an eldery woman’s home; she’s in agony after a fall and can’t get to the door to let them in. Hannah comes to the rescue of a student who’s crash landed during a high jump and could have spinal injuries.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nhi and Carlos under pressure to bring a drug overdose patient back from the brink of death. Laura and Aaron are on their way to one job, when they come across a motorbike crash. The rider’s horrific injuries are so bad, he may never walk again. Hannah rushes to an elderly man virtually suffocating from fluid on his lungs while his beloved sweetheart fears the worst. Ben and Tarnya apply their superhero skills to a toddler who’s struggling to breathe.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A young Dad suddenly suffers frightening seizures while driving his wife and baby. Intensive care paramedic, Dan can’t believe the family are still alive. Aaron and Laura treat a serial daredevil with serious injuries after a spectacular crash from his dirt bike. Chris and Sam challenge each other to slip ‘the word of the day’ into their next case. Solo responder Bill fights heavy traffic to help a diabetic grandmother who has collapsed at home and is not responding.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Bill holds a young mother’s life in his hands, as her heart races out of control. Aaron is ready for anything as he resets a netballer’s shoulder, but is he prepared for the cheeky sportswoman’s banter? Sam has ‘man-flu’, so Chris teams up with Laura for the first time. Together they rush to help an elderly Parkinson’s patient with a growing infection that could turn septic. Aaron later joins Dan to rescue a collapsed man with critical head injuries, found in a pool of blood in a car park.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A confronting case for Nhi and Carlos as they are called to a woman running in front of traffic. The woman is in crisis and suddenly jumps out of the ambulance as the paramedics try to help her. Dan helps a star footballer who’s busted his leg at training. Sally and Olivia fear their elderly patient is having a heart attack and new dad, Bill races to a first time Mum whose baby could be having a life-threatening allergic reaction.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A terrified patient with a failing heart has Aaron and Laura on high alert. Dan is called to a stubborn local celebrity. The 79-year-old character needs to be in hospital, but doesn’t trust doctors. Nhi and Carlos share their school memories on the way to to help a teen who’s crashed landed on a basketball court. Chris and Sam meet their oldest ever patient. The stoic 104-year-old Nelly has terrible face injuries after a fall in her house but still gives the boys her secret to longevity.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Bill battles to save a woman with catastrophic head injuries after she fell four metres through a roof onto a concrete floor. Nhi and Carlos meet a delightful patient who’s still smiling after breaking her arm during a family lunch. Laura and Aaron rush to a mum who’s slumped over in her car and is unresponsive. Sally and Olivia handle a lethargic toddler with extra care, after a big bump at the playground.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A sudden collapse shocks Olivia and Sally as their patient suddenly appears to be having a heart attack. Carlos and Nhi fear for their safety as a volatile woman lashes out in the back of the ambulance. Chris and Sam’s protective instincts kick in for a teenage patient who was attacked on his way to school. programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A collection of the fish that didn't make the cut for an episode, so they get their own episode.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A look back at the favorites of Season 3.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: It's that time of the year again. Time to tag some redfish for the FL STAR tournament by CCA. Like always, Leiza and Blair explain the many ways to win big while catching some big reds.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out to the very first spot we ever filmed a BWO show, with the first guide ever on BWO Capt. John Beach. - This time they're catching sheepshead, hopefully nobody gets bit this time.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: In this episode, Tyler sets up before daylight, calls in a stubborn gobbler, and gets a second chance at the bird that’s been haunting him.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Greg Camp heads back to Nebraska for the third year in a row hoping to put his bow tag on a giant 10 Pointer.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Opening Day in Alabama 2026 was one for the books!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Part 2 of our Alabama opening week 2026 hunt with our buddies Lee Hubbard and Daniel McAfee.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Atlanta Braves' third baseman Austin Riley is usually spending his September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs. Being that he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January in Mississippi. This year was no different. He jumped at the opportunity to head down to the Backwoods testing grounds to hunt with the Small Town TV crew in Yazoo City. Austin capitalizes on a first sit opportunity on a true Mississippi giant over a Backwoods Attraction food plot! Three first sit bucks taken for the Road Trips crew at the Backwoods testing grounds!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts kicks off the Georgia bow season with a big 10 pointer.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.

Vishal brings her into his lavish house and makes sure that she's well taken care of. In the same house, she meets Vishal's arrogant brother, Sagar (Govinda) who gets annoyed by her presence. programme.desc: Witness the greatest slashers in cinema history, from Crystal Lake to Elm Street to the Bates Motel and more.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: The dead walk! Seven strangers try to survive the night in a Pennsylvania farmhouse surrounded by flesh-eating zombies.

programme.title: Remembering Romero
programme.desc: Looking back at the iconic films of horror director George A. Romero.

programme.title: The Diary of David Cronenberg
programme.desc: Take a look at the bizarre body horror and sci-fi films of director David Cronenberg.

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: Aliens and Androids have taken a “Fantastic Voyage” to Earth, and now we are all in “Altered States!”

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: “Invaders from Mars” have landed, hired ‘Robocop,” and are all now driving cross-country with “Speed Racer”

programme.title: Mad, Mad, Mad Scientists Vol. 1: Monstrous Minds
programme.desc: Enter the minds of the twisted geniuses who gave birth to monstrous creations and big screen horrors.

programme.title: Mad, Mad, Mad Scientists Vol. 2: The Perils of Playing God
programme.desc: Explore the dark side of scientific ambition, where unhinged minds push the boundaries of big screen horror.

programme.title: Mad, Mad, Mad Scientists Vol. 3: Experiments Gone Awry
programme.desc: Reckless experiments lead to monstrous results in these horrific Hollywood cult hits.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A doctor experimenting with transplant techniques keeps his girlfriend's head alive when she is decapitated in a car crash, then goes hunting for a new body.

programme.title: Joe Dante’s Creature Features
programme.desc: TFH creator Joe Dante pays tribute to the classic creature features that inspired a generation of filmmakers.

programme.title: Future Fury
programme.desc: Take a journey into the future with this collection of celebrated classic sci-fi action movies.

programme.title: The Future of Horror
programme.desc: In space, only the people sitting next to you can hear you scream. So scream loud!

programme.title: The Best of John Carpenter

programme.desc: TFH creator Joe Dante highlights Hollywood's atomic age paranoia and the nightmares unleashed on unsuspecting audiences.

programme.title: Kaiju Classics
programme.desc: Giant monsters are on the rampage! Who will save us?

programme.title: Gamera the Invincible
programme.desc: Atomic scientists unknowingly awaken the colossal prehistoric turtle Gamera, whose titanic rampage threatens to destroy humanity.

programme.title: Atomic Age Sci-fi Classics Vol. 1
programme.desc: Journey back to the 1950s and 60s, where science and imagination brought forth a new wave of classic films.

programme.title: Atomic Age Sci-fi Classics Vol. 2
programme.desc: Monsters, aliens, mutants, and more! Who will save us from cinema's most terrifying atomic-era creatures?

programme.title: The Last Woman On Earth
programme.desc: Roger Corman directed this 1960 sci-fi thriller that follows three people who surface from a scuba expedition to find the entire population has been mysteriously wiped out. Now, the last two surviving men will fight for the Last Woman On Earth!

programme.title: Atomic Age Sci-fi Classics Vol. 3
programme.desc: It's a wild blast from the past, as atomic monsters, aliens, and more invade your living room!

programme.title: Atomic Age Sci-fi Classics Vol. 4
programme.desc: From the depths of space (and deeper), comes an all-new collection of intergalactic invaders and futuristic fears!

programme.title: Teenagers from Outer Space
programme.desc: As if America didn’t have enough trouble with its own teens, a group of young aliens arrive in a flying saucer, commit animal cruelty, and plot to make the planet a breeding ground for gargantuan lobster-like monsters.

programme.title: Impostor Syndrome: The Best of Big Screen Body Snatchers
programme.desc: In these sci-fi classics, no one is quite who they seem, and the threat of invasion is closer than you think.

programme.title: Retro Futures: 80s Sci-Fi Classics
programme.desc: Science fiction dominated cinema screens in the 1980s, and these are the ones we'll always remember.

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: Open a can of “whoop-ass” with the “Swinging Cheerleaders,” “Sex Kittens,” and ‘Switchblade Sisters”

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras la fuerza especial investiga a un grupo paramilitar con raíces en el siglo XV que persigue a los pedófilos, Liz se enfrenta a una decisión crucial acerca de su futuro con Tom.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz unen fuerzas con el grupo de trabajo para detener a un negociador que ha vuelto a aparecer para unir a dos familias criminales rivales. Tom retoma el contacto con un antiguo amor.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La reaparición de un niño que, supuestamente, había muerto dos años atrás lleva a Red y a Liz tras la pista de un siniestro personaje que parece sacado de un cuento de hadas que lleva a cabo sacrificios humanos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El estreno de la temporada comienza con la búsqueda que el FBI hace de Liz por el asesinato del Fiscal General. Red y Liz están en la lista de los 10 Fugitivos más buscados del FBI y se han dado a la fuga para evitar ser capturados. Red recurre a un miembro de La Lista Negra llamado “El Granjero Trol” para que lo ayude a huir de la ciudad, y la fuerza especial debe cuestionarse en quién de los suyos aún puede confiar. Lo colocan a Dembe en una situación peligrosa y comprometida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el FBI buscan a un asesino en serie que publica las fotos de sus víctimas para un proyecto de arte en Internet. Liz se reúne con Tom, que está gravemente herido.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red persigue a un delincuente de la lista negra cuyos secretos amenazan con desatar una ola de ataques de venganza. Mientras planea su futuro con Tom, Liz continúa buscando la verdad sobre su madre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de que Reddington descubra que unos ladrones van detrás de un arma nuclear militar, el grupo de trabajo se ve envuelto en una carrera contrarreloj para detenerlos y así evitar un inminente desastre nuclear. Mientras tanto, Tom y Liz toman una decisión que cambiará su relación para siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz presiona a una fuente para obtener respuestas, el equipo especial se enfrenta a las implicaciones de sus acciones.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una tragedia ha puesto a un miembro del equipo en grave peligro, por lo que el grupo de trabajo debe confiar en Red y sus poco convencionales métodos para sobrevivir. Mientras tanto, Tom y Liz se enfrentan a una complicación inesperada que podría afectar al futuro de su bebé.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una mujer atractiva y misteriosa que huye de unos atacantes desconocidos se cruza accidentalmente con Reddington y recurre a su ayuda para luchar contra sus atacantes.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Una pérdida inesperada ha dejado devastado al grupo de trabajo del FBI, que debe rastrear a sus atacantes: un misterioso grupo cuyos agentes operan usando una red de satélites global. Mientras tanto, Reddington se ve obligado a enfrentarse a un fantasma de su pasado que conoce muchos secretos sobre él.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington vincula a una mujer poderosa y extremadamente peligrosa con la reciente tragedia. El grupo de trabajo deberá perseguirla para detenerla antes de que vuelva a atacar.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La búsqueda de venganza del grupo de trabajo del FBI se acerca a su final. programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Reddington y la fuerza especial están a punto de encontrar al responsable de la muerte de Liz, una inesperada traición los obliga a apresurarse para salvar a uno de los suyos.

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red (James Spader) envía a Liz (Megan Boone) y a la Fuerza de Tareas a perseguir a un ecoterrorista con una misteriosa conexión con Alexander Kirk, Tom (Ryan Eggold) toma cartas en el asunto.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz sigue a Red hasta Ginebra en busca de Kirk. La fuerza especial va detrás de una turbia organización que asesina inventores prometedores para que sus nuevas tecnologías no lleguen a comercializarse.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Alexander Kirk contrata a un misterioso grupo que se especializa en hackear los sistemas informáticos más seguros del mundo, Red y Liz ven una oportunidad para hacerle una propuesta a la organización de Kirk.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red le pide a la fuerza especial que vaya tras la pista de una persona que proporciona nuevas identidades a criminales en fuga. Mientras tanto, a medida que la salud de Alexander Kirk se va deteriorando, Liz recurre a Cooper para que la guíe en una decisión crucial.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La fuga de Kirk del hospital lleva a Red a ofrecerle una cura para su enfermedad hematológica terminal a cambio de la libertad de Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red trabaja entre bambalinas para reincorporar a Liz, la investigación del FBI sobre el robo de un sistema secreto de misiles guiados revela a un inesperado sospechoso.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Las premoniciones de una niña de nueve años proporcionan misteriosas pistas sobre una serie de acontecimientos mortales.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red envía a Liz como agente encubierta para evitar que una banda de ladronas robe una lista con la identidad de personas en el programa de protección de testigos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La búsqueda del dinero perdido de Red revela un plan para convertir a una mujer inmune a una enfermedad terminal en una poderosa arma biológica.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red recurre a la fuerza especial para detener a un inteligente asesino que ha sido contratado para sacarlo a la luz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red intenta averiguar quién le está pagando a Isabella Stone para atacarlo, lo que lleva al FBI a investigar el plan de un delincuente de la lista negra para apropiarse de una red de hackers clandestina.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red intenta exponer a un traidor dentro de su círculo interno, pero su plan se ve frustrado cuando se enferma por un misterioso veneno.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de semanas de buscar a Dembe, Red y la fuerza especial finalmente tienen una pista sobre su paradero, cuando Aram desaparece. Mientras tanto, Dembe asume un riesgo calculado cuando Red está a punto de dar con él.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo rastrea a un médico que ayuda a delincuentes a crear nuevas identidades, Liz y Jennifer unen sus fuerzas para saber cómo Red se ha hecho pasar por su padre durante más de treinta años.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Recuerdos del pasado hacen que Red se cruce en el camino de un enemigo que está dispuesto a destruir su imperio delictivo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La fuerza especial persigue a un hábil cazarrecompensas, cuyo objetivo son los socios más cercanos a Red. Mientras tanto, Ressler se enfrenta a un dilema moral cuando asume un nuevo compromiso con un antiguo colega.

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Un justiciero psicópata persigue a Liz, mientras que Red y el Sr. Kaplan se preparan para su último enfrentamiento.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo de la lista negra trata de cazar al topo del FBI, Liz (Megan Boone) descubre una sorprendente conexión entre un asesino en serie y sus víctimas. Red (James Spader) localiza, uno a uno, a todos los que intentaron atentar contra su vida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red usa a una serie de cómplices para dar con Mr. Kaplan, el grupo de trabajo es investigado por concederle inmunidad para avanzar en su búsqueda.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red contrata a un profesional poderoso para socavar el juicio del gobierno contra la fuerza especial. Cooper y el Sr. Kaplan se proponen revelar la verdad sobre su papel en la vida de Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Con su imperio criminal en ruinas, un Red sorprendentemente despreocupado recluta a Liz en un plan poco probable para ganar efectivo simultáneamente y entregar a un nuevo Blacklister al Task Force. Mientras Liz se enfrenta a la nueva realidad de trabajar junto a su padre, Ressler se encuentra en una posición precaria y Tom sopesa sus opciones.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y la Task Force se unen a Red en una aventura internacional en busca de un multimillonario que trabaja como ladrón de arte de alto nivel. Mientras tanto, Dembe persigue una pista y Tom busca ayuda externa para identificar los restos en la maleta.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras el Task Force investiga una serie de tiroteos policiales sospechosos, el agente Ressler se distrae con las crecientes presiones externas. Entre la espada y la pared, Red recluta a Tom para la ejecución de un elaborado plan que ayude a restablecer su reputación criminal.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y el Task Force buscan a un escurridizo criminal que no se detendrá ante nada para destruir algunos de los tesoros más preciados del mundo. programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Red proporciona información exclusiva sobre un terrorista internacional, enfrenta a Liz y a la Task Force a una colisión con una unidad rival de la CIA. Mientras tanto, Red y Hawkins preparan el terreno para su nuevo negocio y Tom se infiltra en busca de información.

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Tom desaparece y Liz vuelve sobre sus pasos desesperadamente para encontrarlo. Mientras tanto, la búsqueda de la maleta de huesos por parte de Red lo enfrenta a una colisión con Tom que cambiará la vida de todos para siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz abandona su antigua vida y busca un nuevo comienzo en un lugar donde nadie conoce su historia, su nombre o la profundidad de su dolor. Cuando una amenaza inesperada la encuentra, se ve obligada a recurrir a su fuerza emocional y física en una brutal lucha por la supervivencia.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Red dirige al grupo de trabajo para encontrar a un Blacklister que usa su posición de poder para vender información sensible, Ressler se encuentra en riesgo de ser expuesto. Mientras tanto, Liz planea su próximo movimiento.

programme.desc: Cuando Red va en busca de un tesoro legendario, llama la atención de Abraham Stern (la estrella invitada Nathan Lane), un astuto manipulador que ha dedicado su vida y la de muchos inocentes a recuperar la fortuna que le pertenece desde su nacimiento.
